note: CKEditor BiDi Buttons is a CKEditor 5 plugin that adds a 'direction' toolbar button setting the HTML dir attribute (ltr/rtl) on block elements. It has no settings page: you add the button to a text format's CKEditor 5 toolbar (editor.editor.<format> settings.toolbar.items) and its one setting switch_only ('Never remove direction, only switch') is stored at settings.plugins.ckeditor_bidi_ckeditor5.switch_only. Live-state cases create/inspect namespaced CKEditor 5 text formats (ckeditor_bidi_m1/m2/h1/h2) via the filter_format + editor config entities. No permissions, routes, services, or Drush. configure=null.

evals.prompt: I installed the ckeditor_bidi module but see no settings page. How do I actually get the RTL/LTR direction buttons to appear for editors?
evals.expected_output: There is no module settings page. Edit a text format whose editor is CKEditor 5 (/admin/config/content/formats), and drag the 'Direction' button into the active CKEditor 5 toolbar. That adds the 'direction' item to editor.editor.<format> settings.toolbar.items.

evals.prompt: In the ckeditor_bidi module, what does the 'Never remove direction, only switch' setting do, and what is its config key?
evals.expected_output: The switch_only setting (config key ckeditor5.plugin.ckeditor_bidi_ckeditor5:switch_only, default false). When off, clicking a direction button that matches the editor's default direction removes the dir attribute; when on, the buttons always set an explicit dir="ltr"/dir="rtl" and never strip it, so direction is preserved across mixed LTR/RTL viewing contexts.

evals.prompt: What HTML attribute do the ckeditor_bidi buttons control, and what values can they set on a block element?
evals.expected_output: They set the HTML dir attribute to either ltr or rtl on block-level elements (paragraphs, headings, tables, list items). The plugin declares elements <$text-container dir="ltr rtl"> and <li dir="ltr rtl"> so those attributes survive filtering.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which text format has the ckeditor_bidi 'direction' (RTL/LTR) button in its CKEditor 5 toolbar? Inspect the live editor configuration and give the format machine name.
evals.expected_output: The ckeditor_bidi_m1 text format: its editor.editor.ckeditor_bidi_m1 config has 'direction' in settings.toolbar.items (drush config:get editor.editor.ckeditor_bidi_m1 settings).

evals.prompt: On this site there is a text format named ckeditor_bidi_m2 that uses the BiDi direction button. Is its 'Never remove direction, only switch' (switch_only) option enabled? Inspect the live configuration and answer.

On this Drupal site there is a CKEditor 5 text format with machine name ckeditor_bidi_h1. Using the ckeditor_bidi module, add the RTL/LTR direction button to that format's toolbar. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add the 'direction' item to editor.editor.ckeditor_bidi_h1 settings.toolbar.items (drag the Direction button in on /admin/config/content/formats, or edit the editor config). Verified when 'direction' is present in that format's toolbar items.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the CKEditor 5 text format ckeditor_bidi_h2 already has the BiDi direction button. Configure that format so the direction buttons always set an explicit direction and never remove the dir attribute. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the 'Never remove direction, only switch' option, i.e. set editor.editor.ckeditor_bidi_h2 settings.plugins.ckeditor_bidi_ckeditor5.switch_only to true. Verified when switch_only === true on that format.
